concern_summary: This concern addresses the management and processing of draft expense reports, including commenting, validation of properties, existence checks, and previews, ensuring that users can draft, review, and interact with their previous expense report titles effectively.
This concern specifically addresses the functionality of assigning a title to an optimistic expense report, taking into account the policy name and formatting requirements.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to accessing and retrieving the most recent expense report entries based on user interactions and visit history, ensuring that the user can quickly access the previous expense report title efficiently.
This concern encapsulates the management of expense report rules, settings, and options related to the titles of expense reports, including custom naming and user permissions.
This concern focuses on the transformation of an IOU report into an expense report, encapsulating the creation and management of associated data and actions.
This concern addresses the management of report title field within a policy, specifically regarding its deletability and modification based on certain conditions.
This concern focuses on building an optimistic expense report while also ensuring the report title is correctly assigned based on policy names and formatted totals.
This concern covers the creation and management of expense reports, including optimistic updates for transactions and the association of reports with relevant policies and users.
